full_judgment:
The petitioner preferred these petitions against the orders all dated 3-8-2023 of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case Nos. 45997, 46001, 45994, 45992, 45996 and 45995 of 2023. 

 2. It appears that the High Court Division without enlarging the accused-respondents on anticipatory hail in Metropolitan Special Case .Nos. 141, 140, 139, 137, 138 and 155 of 2022 arising out of Paltan Model Police Station Case Nos. 47, 45, 52, 38, 39 and 51 dated 23-9-2015, .23-9-2015, 23-9-2015, 21-9-2015, 21-9-2015 and 23-9-2015, and corresponding to ACC/Dudok GR Nos. 599, 597, 604, 579, 582 and 603 of 2015, under sections 409/109 and 409/467/468/ 471/109 of the Penal Code 1860 read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947, directed them to surrender before the Court of learned Metropolitan Senior Special Judge, Dhaka within 6 (six) weeks. 

 3. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that in view of the fact that charge-sheet has already been submitted against the accused-respondents, the High Court Division should have summarily rejected the case. Instead of doing so, the High Court Division has given direction to surrender which is contrary to the decision of the Appellate Division. 

 7. Accordingly, the impugned orders all dated 3-8-2023 of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case Nos. 45997, 46001, 45994, 45992, 45996 and 45995 of 2023 are set aside.
